Real-time deep research
Researches every prospect across the web using your CRM data, value prop, and ICP. The highest accuracy on the market.
Signal-based copywriting
Start from your TAM. Twain finds signals and writes every touchpoint from email to LinkedIn to calls, backed by deep research.
API-first platform
Run Twain agents wherever you work. Through native integrations in Clay, your own API builds, or MCP in Claude Code. No lock-in.
Adaptive personas
Import personas from any source and let Twain instantly tailor the perfect pain point, USP, and social proof for every lead
Upload Document
Personalize
Relevant insight
ARRtist Circus improved its outbound sales process using Honeysales, an AI solution, achieving a 7-8% message-to-meeting conversion rate, significantly above the industry average of 0.5-1%. This led to faster lead conversion and efficient sales workflow. (Honeysales Case Study)
Pain point
Manual research for sales prospecting consumes considerable time, yielding incomplete or outdated information, making it difficult to identify and engage potential customers efficiently.
Cost of inaction
Continuing manual data collection and research raises operational expenses and causes lost productivity across sales and marketing teams.
Solution
Clay allows building targeted lead lists using over 100 sources and AI, and connecting/auto-updating CRM as a source of truth.
Objection
It may feel difficult to trust automated research and AI tools to replace manual research processes for high-value outreach.
Competitive advantage
AI agents automate manual research at scale, such as summarizing job posts, flagging domains, and building custom lead scoring models.
Social proof
Over 300.000 GTM teams of all sizes use Clay's platform to track signals, enrich data, and use AI personalization.
Custom onboarding
